items.title: Weak heat solutions on the continuum torus
items.statement: Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice ($\mathrm{AC}_\omega$), meaning every at most countable family of nonempty sets has a choice function. Let $d\ge1$, let $\mathbb T^d=(\mathbb R/\mathbb Z)^d$ carry the normalized product Haar measure $dx$ with $dx(\mathbb T^d)=1$, and let $\rho_0$ be a real measurable function on $\mathbb T^d$ with $0\le\rho_0\le1$ almost everywhere. items.title: Connectedness of fixed-occupancy exclusion sectors
items.statement: Let $G=(V,E)$ be a finite connected simple undirected graph with $m:=|V|\ge1$. For $0\le k\le m$, let $\mathcal C_k(G)$ be the set of all $k$-element subsets of $V$. Join distinct $A,B\in\mathcal C_k(G)$ when there is an edge $\{x,y\}\in E$ with $x\in A$, $y\notin A$, and $B=(A\setminus\{x\})\cup\{y\}$. Then this graph on $\mathcal C_k(G)$ is connected.

references.title: Shiba Biswal and Nicolas Lanchier, The simple exclusion process on finite connected graphs
references.locator: Section 3, Lemmas 5–6 and proof: fixed-particle configurations are communicating classes. The statement here is graph-theoretic and is proved locally.

items.proof_route: Construct a spanning tree and prove connectivity of each k-subset graph by leaf induction.

items.title: Symmetric exclusion process under diffusive scaling
items.statement: Assume the Axiom of Choice, meaning every family of nonempty sets has a choice function. Fix an integer $d\ge1$ and an integer $N\ge3$. Let $\Lambda_N=(\mathbb Z/N\mathbb Z)^d$, with each coordinate represented by $0,1,\ldots,N-1$, and let $\mathcal E_N$ be the set of unordered nearest-neighbor bonds $\{x,x+e_i\}$, where $1\le i\le d$ and addition is modulo $N$. The condition $N\ge3$ makes this a simple graph with each bond listed once as $x$ ranges over $\Lambda_N$. The site graph is connected because any two coordinate tuples are joined by finitely many steps of $+e_i$ or $-e_i$.
